title: Reduce Completed diagnostics helper exports
summary: Removed two transitional flat window.* aliases for Completed diagnostics helper functions after moving Diagnostics handoff consumers to window.mediaPipelineCompletedView.
reason: Continue namespace-first WebView cleanup in a scoped Diagnostics/Completed handoff slice while preserving intentional flat compatibility hooks still used by other page-owned consumers.
behavior_before: Diagnostics owner-handoff code read Completed review rows and final-trust step selection through direct window.completedReviewRows and window.selectCompletedFinalTrustStep flat aliases, while completedView.js also exposed those helpers through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView.
behavior_after: Diagnostics owner-handoff code reads Completed review rows and final-trust step selection through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView, and completedView.js keeps those two helpers namespace-only. Remaining Completed flat aliases are unchanged for current consumers.
tests_added: Updated tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_local_api.py to require Completed namespace exports and served-source absence for the removed flat aliases.
Updated tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static.py to require Diagnostics consumers to use mediaPipelineCompletedView and to reject the removed flat helper lookups.
manual_validation: rg -n "window\.(completedReviewRows|selectCompletedFinalTrustStep)\b" apps tests docs --glob '!docs/generated/summaries/**' (only negative assertions and historical changelog text remain)
rollback_plan: Revert this change packet to restore the two direct Completed diagnostics helper window.* aliases, move Diagnostics handoff consumers back to the flat helper lookups, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline and summaries, and restore the prior flat export counts in docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md and docs/inventories/WEBVIEW_GLOBAL_EXPORT_INVENTORY.md.
